scripts.build: cd ../cloudflare && bun run build:all && cd ../self-hosted && mkdir -p dist && cp ../cloudflare/dist/worker.js dist/worker.js && esbuild src/assetsWorker.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/assets-worker.js && rm -rf public && cp -r ../../apps/web/dist public
scripts.integration: bun run build && cd ../cloudflare && INTEGRATION_RUNTIME=workerd bun scripts/integration.ts
